SYNTHETIC AUTHORITY ANALYSIS

See the gap between access and use.

Inspect standing permissions, exercised authority, and what a compromised identity could reach. Then widen a delegation edge and watch the result change.

Every fleet and event on this page is synthetic and seeded. These numbers describe the demonstration, not a customer deployment. Definitions and denominators accompany the published benchmark.

Metric definitions ↗
Published synthetic benchmark ↗
Explore the analyzer ↓

01 · THE AUTHORITY INVENTORY

What is held. What is used. What remains.

These eight synthetic identities have the most unused granted scopes in this sample. Dormant means a granted scope had zero allowed calls in the observation window; it does not by itself prove that permission should be removed.

05 · DELEGATED AUTHORITY

Widen one edge. Watch the root's blast radius move.

A correct capability token can only narrow as it is delegated, so an ancestor reaches exactly its own grant. Break that on any edge and authority flows back up the tree.
